statement: This is an app for people who are tired of too many pings from all directions, and want one calm place to stay close to their closest friends, connections and buddies, or their family.
whatText: It is an app for talking to the few people you care about most. Think of a small table with seven chairs. You choose who sits there. Nobody else gets in.
seatsText: Each friend takes one seat. When all seven are taken, you free a seat before you add someone new. This keeps your circle small and close. Work, buddies and family can each have their own circle with their own seven seats.
sendText: Send text, pictures, videos and voice messages. Open a friend and write in the box at the bottom, like a normal chat.
lockText: Everything you send is locked on your own phone or computer before it leaves it. Think of a letter in a box with a padlock. Only you and your friend have the key. Our server only sees scrambled nonsense and has no key, so it cannot open your messages. Nobody who broke into it could either.
lockWhatText: The text you write, and also every picture, video and voice message. Safebox items are locked the same way. Each friend, and each small group, has its own locked room.
calmTitle: Calm, but you can still reach people
calmText: No big feed, no strangers and no advertisements. If something cannot wait, send a ping. If you need a break from someone, put them on your sleep list: you stay friends, but you stop hearing from them until you wake them up again.
freeText: Yes. There is nothing to pay, there are no advertisements, and your information is not sold.
start1: Make your account. It takes a minute.
start2: Write your name, so your friends know who you are.
start3: Press an empty seat to add a friend. Send a friend request, or share a link with them.
start4: When your friend says yes, you are friends in the app. Now you can write to each other.
safeboxTitle: A shared safebox for each friend and group
safeboxText: Each friend and each small group has a safebox that only the people in it share. Everyone in it can add, open and take out things: pictures, videos, files, notes, secrets, dates, tickets, places, contacts and checklists. A new item shows up in your chat. Everything is locked on your device, so not even we can read it.
disclaimer: This app is made and operated by BlueBoot R&D AS. It runs in the cloud, and it is secured. User data is encrypted and out of reach for us, the cloud provider or anyone else. BlueBoot R&D AS has no agreements with any third party about the use or operation of this app, besides Google and its use of Google Cloud. It will stay small and independent.

scene8m: Lisa: Need a hand with the deck?
reserve: We reserve the right to limit the number of users of this app.
